items.title: Lonar Lake Added to IUGS Geological Heritage List
items.summary: Lonar Lake has been added to the IUGS Geological Heritage List.

items.title: Government Targets SVAMITVA Scheme Saturation by March 2027
items.summary: The government has set a target to achieve full saturation of the SVAMITVA Scheme by March 2027.

items.title: ICJ Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide During 2017 Clearance Operations Against Rohingya
items.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide during its 2017 clearance operations against the Rohingya minority. However, the court has no mechanisms to enforce its ruling.

items.title: Google Commits $5 Million to IIT Kharagpur AI Research
items.summary: Google has committed $5 million to support artificial intelligence research at IIT Kharagpur.

items.title: NCTE Names Kiran Bedi National Mentor under MITRA Initiative
items.summary: The National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) has named Kiran Bedi as a National Mentor under the MITRA initiative.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab triggers fatal landslides in Eastern Ghats region of Odisha
items.summary: Landslides triggered by Cyclone Arnab caused ten deaths in the fragile Eastern Ghats region of Odisha. The incident highlighted growing ecological risks associated with climate extremes, deforestation, and unplanned development in the area.

items.title: COP31 Draft Released by Conference President Murat Kurum in Turkiye
items.summary: COP31 President Murat Kurum presented the final draft text at the climate conference in Turkiye, providing negotiators three hours to submit objections before plenary proceedings.

items.title: Colleen Begg Receives Tusk Lifetime Achievement Award
items.summary: Colleen Begg has been awarded the Tusk Lifetime Achievement Award.

items.title: Shekhar C. Mande Nominated to UN Science and Technology Group
items.summary: Shekhar C. Mande has been nominated to the UN Science and Technology Group.
keywords: Organization: UN Science and Technology Group

items.title: Karnataka Wins Maiden Senior Women’s T20 Trophy
items.summary: Karnataka won their maiden title in the Senior Women’s T20 Trophy.
keywords: Sports Event: Senior Women’s T20 Trophy

items.title: India defeats South Africa in shortest Test match in cricket history
items.summary: India defeated South Africa by seven wickets in Cape Town to win the second Test, which became the shortest match in Test cricket history. India completed the victory in 642 balls, breaking Australia's 1932 record of 656 balls in Melbourne.
keywords: Record: Shortest Test match in history (642 balls)

items.title: Mumbai Indians defeat Delhi Capitals to win inaugural Women’s Premier League title
items.summary: Mumbai Indians won the inaugural edition of the Women's Premier League by defeating Delhi Capitals by seven wickets. Nat Sciver-Brunt hit an unbeaten 60 and captain Harmanpreet Kaur scored 37 as Mumbai reached 134 for 3 in 19.3 overs.

items.title: Mandatory second phase of aviation carbon offsetting scheme CORSIA to start in January 2027
items.summary: The mandatory second phase of the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) becomes effective from January 2027. Under this scheme, a wider group of international airlines, including Indian carriers, will be brought under binding carbon-offsetting obligations.
keywords: Scheme: Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation

items.title: Divya defeats Humpy to become India's first women's World Cup winner
items.summary: Teenager Divya outlasted Humpy to emerge as India's first women's World Cup winner.

items.title: Shrivatri becomes India’s 100th Chess Grandmaster after winning ASEAN Plus Championship
items.summary: Shrivatri became India's 100th Grandmaster after earning the title directly by winning the ASEAN Plus Individual Open Chess Championship. The tournament took place in Ozamiz City, the Philippines.
keywords: Event: ASEAN Plus Individual Open Chess Championship

items.title: DRDO Scientist P.C. Jain Receives Murli Manohar Joshi Award
items.summary: DRDO scientist Prakash Chand Jain received the Murli Manohar Joshi Award. An alumnus of IIT Roorkee and IIT Bombay, his work resulted in substantial weight reductions in missile airframes.

items.title: European Union Refuses to Endorse COP31 Antalya Pact Over Missing Fossil Fuel Language
items.summary: Ireland’s Climate and Energy Minister Darragh O’Brien stated that the European Union will not endorse the COP31 climate draft, termed the Antalya Pact, because it fails to mention fossil fuels. The decision threw the outcome of the UN climate talks into uncertainty during record extra time.

items.title: Spacecraft BepiColombo Begins Orbit of Mercury
items.summary: The joint Japan-Europe spacecraft BepiColombo has begun orbiting Mercury. The space mission seeks to investigate Mercury's magnetic field, ice in its polar craters, and surface depressions known as hollows.

items.title: Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana Set Record India T20 Partnership
items.summary: Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana shared a 162-run opening stand, recording India's highest partnership for any wicket in Women's T20Is. The pair currently holds all three of India's highest partnerships in the format.
keywords: Players: Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana

items.title: India and Nepal to Hold 20th Exercise Suryakiran
items.summary: India and Nepal are set to hold the 20th edition of the joint military exercise Suryakiran.

items.title: India announces offshore IIT campus in Nepal and ₹15,000 crore development package
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the establishment of an offshore Indian Institute of Technology campus in Nepal during the Nepali Prime Minister's visit to India. A development package exceeding ₹15,000 crore and student scholarships were also announced.

items.title: Telangana to launch distribution of one crore Indiramma sarees for women
items.summary: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy will launch the distribution of one crore Indiramma sarees. Beneficiaries must provide their food security cards and Aadhaar details to receive them.

items.title: Pakistan's Zeeshan Ali to join China's Shenzhou-24 space mission
items.summary: Pakistani payload specialist Zeeshan Ali will join China's Shenzhou-24 spaceship as its first foreign astronaut. The participation forms part of bilateral cooperation under China's Belt and Road Initiative.

items.title: RBI Retains D-SIB Status for SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained the Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB) status for State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank. The additional capital requirements are aimed at enhancing the resilience of these institutions.
keywords: Banks: SBI, HDFC Bank, and ICICI Bank

items.title: USA Joint Bid and UK Confirmed as FIFA Women's World Cup Hosts for 2031 and 2035
items.summary: The USA, in partnership with Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica, has been confirmed to host the 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup, which will feature 48 teams for the first time. The United Kingdom has been confirmed as the host for the 2035 edition.
keywords: 2031 Hosts: USA, Mexico, Costa Rica, and Jamaica

items.title: ICMR SAMPADA Survey Finds Lower Anaemia Prevalence
items.summary: The ICMR SAMPADA survey has reported a lower prevalence of anaemia.

items.title: Pakistan’s First Astronaut to Fly on Shenzhou-24 Mission
items.summary: Pakistan’s first astronaut will fly on China’s Shenzhou-24 mission.

items.title: Kerala Set to Launch Avalkkoppam Initiative on 25 November
items.summary: Kerala is scheduled to launch the Avalkkoppam initiative on 25 November.

items.title: CMC Vellore and TIFR Establish India’s First Human Metabolic Chamber
items.summary: CMC Vellore and TIFR have established India’s first Human Metabolic Chamber.

items.title: Pratibha Parkar Accredited as India’s Envoy to Nicaragua
items.summary: Pratibha Parkar has been accredited as India’s envoy to Nicaragua.

items.title: NSA Ajit Doval Emphasizes Colombo Security Conclave and MAHASAGAR Vision
items.summary: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval called for enhanced regional security cooperation in the Indian Ocean, describing the Colombo Security Conclave as the intersection of India's Neighbourhood First outlook and MAHASAGAR vision.

items.title: ICJ Finds Myanmar Responsible for Genocide Against Rohingya in Landmark Ruling
items.summary: The International Court of Justice has found Myanmar responsible for committing genocide against the Rohingya. This marks the first time the court has held a state liable for the crime of genocide.

items.title: Anthropic and Levent Alpöge Announce AI Proof of Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: Levent Alpöge of Anthropic announced that he and the AI model Claude have found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis. The famous mathematical problem concerning the distribution of prime numbers had remained unproven for more than 160 years.

items.title: Indian Women's Hockey Team Rises to Best-Ever Fifth Position in FIH Rankings
items.summary: The Indian women's hockey team achieved its highest-ever position of fifth in the rankings released by the International Hockey Federation (FIH). The Netherlands retained the top spot, followed by Argentina, Belgium, and Spain.

items.title: Anand Kumar Honored with Special Achievement Award in Japan
items.summary: Educator Anand Kumar has received a Special Achievement Award during an event in Japan.

items.title: Shodhan Rai Secures Silver Medal at Natural Olympia 2026
items.summary: Shodhan Rai won the silver medal at the Natural Olympia 2026 competition.

items.title: Ariane 6 Deploys 36 Amazon Satellites from French Guiana
items.summary: Ariane 6 has successfully deployed 36 Amazon satellites into space from French Guiana.

items.title: NIELIT to Build Talent Pipeline for Amaravati Quantum Valley
items.summary: The National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) will build a talent pipeline covering technicians, operators, and researchers for the Amaravati Quantum Valley, stated Director General Madan Mohan Tripathi.

items.title: China Launches Spacecraft Carrying First Pakistani Astronaut to Space Station
items.summary: China launched a crewed spaceship carrying the first Pakistani astronaut to its space station. The spacecraft took off using a Long March-2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China.

items.title: China to Launch Shenzhou-20 Spaceflight Carrying Three Astronauts on April 24
items.summary: China is scheduled to launch the Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on April 24. The mission will carry three astronauts: Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui, and Wang Jie.

items.title: India records 378.53 million tonnes of foodgrain production in 2025-26, says Agriculture Minister
items.summary: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced that India produced a record 378.53 million tonnes of foodgrains in the 2025–26 crop year. Releasing the first advance estimates for 2026–27, he stated that output is expected to remain on track despite El Niño and inadequate rainfall.

items.title: India and Netherlands sign 17 MoUs including semiconductor fabrication project between TATA Electronics and ASML
items.summary: India and the Netherlands upgraded their bilateral relations by signing 17 MoUs across water, renewable energy, and semiconductors. The key agreements include a semiconductor fabrication project between TATA Electronics and Dutch company ASML.
keywords: Project: TATA Electronics and ASML semiconductor fabrication

items.title: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari Announces ₹1 Lakh Crore Road Projects for West Bengal
items.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari announced road projects worth ₹1 lakh crore for West Bengal. The initiative aims to strengthen road infrastructure in the state and accelerate projects to improve connectivity with neighbouring states.

items.title: Dev Deepavali Celebrated in Varanasi with 21 Lakh Diyas and 2,100 Drones
items.summary: Dev Deepavali was celebrated in Varanasi with the lighting of 21 lakh diyas and a display by 2,100 Made-in-India drones. The drone show depicted Shiv Tandav and Ganga Avtaran.

items.title: Karnataka charts India's first comprehensive care and rehabilitation policy for burns survivors
items.summary: Karnataka has formulated India's first comprehensive care and rehabilitation policy for burns survivors. The state will set up 15-bed burns care wards in district hospitals and upgrade the Mahabodhi Burns Care Centre at BMCRI into a Centre of Excellence.
keywords: Policy: Care and rehabilitation policy for burns survivors

items.title: India and China hold second round of Corps Commander talks on LAC in Arunachal Pradesh
items.summary: India and China concluded their second round of Corps Commander-level talks on November 24, 2026. The meeting aimed to ease tensions along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh.
keywords: Place: Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh
Event: Second round of Corps Commander-level talks

items.title: Rahul Madan Takes Charge as IBBI Chairperson
items.summary: Rahul Madan has officially taken charge as the Chairperson of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI).

items.title: JAXA Unveils Rover Prototype for Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX Mission in Japan
items.summary: Japanese space agency JAXA unveiled the rover prototype for the Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX lunar mission in Japan on November 25. The Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX project is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions.

items.title: WCD and Skill Development Ministries to jointly launch Navya 2.0 in Haridwar
items.summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development along with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship will jointly launch Navya 2.0 in Haridwar on November 28, 2026.
keywords: Ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

items.title: Bhargavastra Counter-Drone System Completes Trials in Pokhran
items.summary: The Bhargavastra Counter-Drone System has successfully completed its trials conducted in Pokhran.

items.title: India Plans Fifth S-400 Deployment Along Pakistan Border by February 2027
items.summary: India plans to deploy its fifth S-400 air defence system unit along the Pakistan border by February 2027.

items.title: JAXA Unveils Rover Prototype for Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX Mission
items.summary: The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) has unveiled the prototype of the rover for the joint Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX mission.

items.title: Sabita Toppo Wins Gold in 100-Metre Hurdles at BIMSTEC U-23 Championships
items.summary: Sabita Toppo won the gold medal in the 100-metre hurdles event at the BIMSTEC U-23 Championships.

items.title: Hera Mission Reveals Impact of DART on Dimorphos
items.summary: Findings from the Hera mission have revealed details regarding DART's impact on Dimorphos.

items.title: Telangana's Traditional Martial Art Karra Samu to Be Showcased at Khelo India
items.summary: Telangana's traditional stick-fighting art, Karra samu, will be showcased for the first time at a national event during Khelo India. Demonstrations of the martial art will take place at the Hakimpet Sports School.

items.title: UN Declares November 27 as International Day for Elimination of Child Marriage
items.summary: The United Nations has declared November 27 as the International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage. Additionally, the National Family Health Survey (2023-24) reports that Rajasthan ranks sixth among Indian states in child marriage prevalence.
keywords: Important Day: International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage

items.title: Methil Radhakrishnan Receives Keralam's Ezhuthachan Award
items.summary: Writer Methil Radhakrishnan has been presented with the Ezhuthachan Award, Keralam’s highest literary honour, at an event in Kozhikode.

items.title: Centre proposes Constitutional Amendment Bill freezing Lok Sabha seat proportions until 2051
items.summary: The Union government proposed a new Constitutional Amendment Bill and a Delimitation Bill to freeze Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051. The proposed legislation seeks to increase Lok Sabha seats per State by 50% and enforce 33% reservation for women.

items.title: India and Nepal release ten-pillar vision document during Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit
items.summary: Indian and Nepali delegations released a ten-pillar vision document titled 'Viksit Bharat-Samunnat Nepal: Reimagining the Partnership'. The statement was issued during the visit of Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah.
keywords: Document: Viksit Bharat-Samunnat Nepal: Reimagining the Partnership

items.title: Supreme Court directs FSSAI to mandate front-of-pack nutrition labelling for packaged foods
items.summary: The Supreme Court has directed the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) to introduce a single-phase front-of-pack nutrition labelling (FoPNL) regime. The court gave the regulator four months to finalise the draft regulations.
keywords: Organization: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India

items.title: Magsaysay awardee Rajendra Singh opposes Sabarmati model for Musi river development
items.summary: Magsaysay awardee Rajendra Singh advised planting trees along the Musi river banks rather than concretising them like the Sabarmati model. He spoke during a curtain-raiser event for the Telangana Climate Conclave.

items.title: SCO Civilizational Forum in New Delhi issues Indraprastha Communique
items.summary: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilizational Forum was held in New Delhi, organised by the Ministry of Culture and Ministry of External Affairs. The dialogue resulted in the adoption of the Indraprastha Communique.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh Khadi Mahotsav begins in Lucknow on theme of progress through Khadi
items.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Khadi Mahotsav has commenced in Lucknow with 150 stalls set up by Khadi and Village Industries entrepreneurs. The event is organised around the theme 'Culture in Threads, Progress through Khadi'.
keywords: Theme: Culture in Threads, Progress through Khadi

items.title: ISRO invites Indian industry to build human space flight analog simulation facility
items.summary: The Bengaluru-based Human Space Flight Centre of ISRO issued an Expression of Interest to develop a human space flight analog simulation facility. The EOI was issued to engage Indian industry.

items.title: Revised Delimitation Bill proposes increasing maximum State Assembly ceiling from 500 to 650 seats
items.summary: The Union Cabinet's revised delimitation bill proposes raising the constitutional limit on State Assembly seats from 500 to 650. The provision enables the Uttar Pradesh Assembly to expand to 605 members without requiring a division of the State.

items.title: RBI cuts daily CRR maintenance requirement to 90% to release over ₹40,000 crore
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India lowered the minimum daily Cash Reserve Ratio maintenance to 90%, freeing up more than ₹40,000 crore. The move aims to enhance banks' liquidity flexibility and support credit deployment.
